TBF Player Box Score

Source: R/tbf.R
tbf_player_box.Rd

Player box score of a finished game: minutes, shooting splits, rebounds, assists, +/- and efficiency.

Endpoint: GET https://miniappapi.tbf.org.tr/webapi-service/api/Match/mac-istatistik

Usage

tbf_player_box(match_id)

Arguments

match_id

Required. TBF game id (integer), e.g. 346279; match_id in tbf_schedule(). One global sequence across leagues and seasons. Only a finished game is served.

Value

A hoopR_data tibble. One row per player who is on the sheet; is_starter marks the starting five (none flagged in 2006-07). Every column below is always present (a zero-row tibble keeps them and their types); an answer with nothing in it raises hoopR_no_data, as in sportsdataverse-py.

col_nametypedescription
match_idintegerTBF game id (key space: TBF games, ONE global sequence across leagues and seasons: 62552 in 2006-07, 346279 in 2026-27). The match_id argument of every game wrapper; the routes echo it as a string or null, the runtime stamps the integer asked for.
sidecharacterSide of the game the row belongs to: home or away (from the route's isHome flag or home / away block).
team_process_idintegerTeam-season id of the player's side (from the game header; key space: TBF team registrations).
player_idintegerTBF person id (key space: TBF persons, stable across seasons and clubs: 196413). The same value as person_id in the player and team tables and the player_id argument of tbf_player_career.
player_namecharacterPlayer name as TBF prints it for that route (title case, Turkish letters kept).
jersey_numbercharacterShirt number as a string, so '0' and '00' stay distinct.
is_starterlogicalTrue for the starting five (homeTopFive / awayTopFive block); none are flagged in 2006-07.
seconds_playedintegerTime on court in seconds, parsed from the 'mm:ss' or 'hh:mm:ss' text the API sends (team totals sum their players, so 200:00 = 12000).
pointsintegerPoints scored in the game (or season) the row covers.
fg_madeintegerField goals made, 2PT + 3PT (successfulShots).
fg_attemptedintegerField goals attempted, 2PT + 3PT (shotAttempts).
fg_pctintegerField-goal percentage 0-100, rounded to an integer by the API.
fg2_madeintegerTwo-point field goals MADE (the API calls it twoPointShots; attempts are fg2_attempted).
fg2_attemptedintegerTwo-point field goals attempted (twoPointShotAttempts).
fg2_pctintegerTwo-point percentage 0-100, an integer.
fg3_madeintegerThree-point field goals MADE (the API calls it threePointShots).
fg3_attemptedintegerThree-point field goals attempted (threePointShotAttempts).
fg3_pctintegerThree-point percentage 0-100, an integer.
ft_madeintegerFree throws MADE (serbest atis; the API calls it freeThrows).
ft_attemptedintegerFree throws attempted (freeThrowAttempts).
ft_pctintegerFree-throw percentage 0-100, an integer.
off_reboundsintegerOffensive rebounds (hucum ribaundu).
def_reboundsintegerDefensive rebounds (savunma ribaundu).
reboundsintegerTotal rebounds (toplam ribaund).
assistsintegerAssists in this game (asist).
stealsintegerSteals in this game (top calma).
blocksintegerShots this player blocked in this game (blok).
turnoversintegerTurnovers committed in this game (top kaybi).
foulsintegerPersonal fouls committed (faul).
fouls_drawnintegerFouls drawn (rivalFoul = foul committed by the opponent).
blocks_receivedintegerOwn shots blocked by an opponent (blocksReceived).
plus_minusintegerPlus/minus while on court (plusMinus); null when the API sends ”.
efficiencyintegerEfficiency rating (verimlilik puani, PIR): points + rebounds + assists + steals + blocks + fouls drawn - missed shots - turnovers - fouls. An integer on player rows.

Details

Official TBF app API, unofficial for SportsDataverse: the backend of the Turkish Basketball Federation's mobile app (miniappapi.tbf.org.tr), which serves BSL, TBL, KBSL and the other TBF leagues. It needs no key; robots.txt answers 404 on the host, and the runtime spaces requests at least 1 s apart. TBF's terms were not reviewed; check them before you republish the data. The vendor's origin hosts (nikayazilim.com) serve the same data without Cloudflare but are deliberately not used, redirects are never followed, and www.tbf.org.tr's interactive Turnstile is neither used nor automated.

Coverage: season and competition are parameters (bsl Basketbol Super Ligi, back to 1966-67 in the league list; tbl second tier; kbsl women, both from 2015-16). Game wrappers serve FINISHED games only (an unfinished game raises hoopR_asset_fetch). Box scores exist from 2006-07 (no starters flagged that season); play-by-play and shots from 2025-26 only, an earlier finished game raises hoopR_no_data. Every game carries a Genius LiveStats id (genius_id, joins the genius family) from 2018-19 on some seasons and on every game of 2025-26 and later. Birth dates, contact details, photos and logos are dropped. Names and category labels are Turkish; the column descriptions give the English gloss.

Errors: hoopR_no_data when TBF has nothing for the request (HTTP 404, an unknown game or player, a season the league list lacks, an empty list, a finished game before 2025-26 asked for play-by-play or shots); hoopR_bad_request for an invalid argument or HTTP 400 / 422; hoopR_asset_fetch when the fetch failed or the answer is not the one asked for (an unfinished game, a body for another game, season, league or team, an error envelope, a redirect, a partial page or a changed capped list). All inherit hoopR_error. Timestamps are Turkey local time (Europe/Istanbul).
